name: Bren
background: Bren fought in two border wars and now burns charcoal in the hills, coming down to the inn when his sacks are sold.
temperament: Gruff and quarrelsome when drinking, loyal to old comrades to the bone; courage he has, tact he lacks.
speech: Loud, coarse, full of war stories; calls younger men 'boy' whatever their age.
quirks: Shows his scars unasked; drinks fast; keeps his knife on the table.
secret: He deserted at the end of the second war and has lied about it ever since.
goal: Drink the coin from his charcoal, find an old comrade to share stories with, and prove he can still win at darts.
